# FQHELatticeEntanglementSpectrum

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnLattice` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnLattice/FQHELatticeEntanglementSpectrum`

```text
FQHELatticeEntanglementSpectrum, version 0.01

Usage: FQHELatticeEntanglementSpectrum [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --density-matrix : file containing the reduced density matrix
    -n, --nbr-particles : number of particles in the A part (default value = 0)
    -o, --output : output name for the entanglement spectrum (default name replace density-matrix full.ent extension with la_x_na_y.entspec)
    -e, --eigenvalue-error : lowest acceptable reduced density matrix eigenvalue (default value = 1e-14)
    --xi-error : minus log of the lowest acceptable reduced density matrix eigenvalue (o if error control relies on the eigenvalue-error option) (default value = 0)
    --show-minmaxkya : show minimum an maximum Ky value that can be reached
    --show-counting : show degeneracy counting for each Ky value
    --particle-entanglement : compute particle entanglement spectrum
    --ky-periodic : set the periodicity for for the ky momentum (0 if non-periodic ) (default value = 0)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
